bug_description: HeifPixelImage::ImageComponent::crop() at pixelimage.cc:1625 performs a memcpy with a size derived from integer arithmetic that underflows to ~4GB (0xFFFFFFF4). A crafted HEIF file with specific crop coordinates triggers a massive heap-buffer-overflow READ of 4,294,967,284 bytes past a 20,751-byte buffer. The crop parameters pass all application-level bounds checks.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/libheif

# Build libheif with ASan via cmake
mkdir -p build && cd build
cmake \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$CC \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$CXX \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$CXXFLAGS" \
    -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF \
    -DWITH_EXAMPLES=OFF \
    -DWITH_GDK_PIXBUF=OFF \
    ..
make -j$(nproc)

# Find the generated heif_version.h directory
VERSION_DIR=$(dirname $(find /src/libheif/build -name "heif_version.h" | head -1))
INCLUDE_GEN=$(dirname "$VERSION_DIR")

# Build harness against the static lib
$CXX $CXXFLAGS \
    -I /src/libheif/libheif/api \
    -I "$INCLUDE_GEN" \
    /src/harness.cpp \
    /src/libheif/build/libheif/libheif.a \
    -lde265 \
    -lpthread \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR libheif.issue-1746..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.heic
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/libheif
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c++
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git cmake pkg-config libde265-dev
RUN git clone https://github.com/strukturag/libheif.git libheif \
    && cd libheif \
    && git checkout d4d83cbfda34bbe5899ede6df204d24fe426284e \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "libheif at d4d83cbf (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/libheif
COPY harness.cpp $SRC/harness.cpp
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.heic /testcase/poc.heic

bug_report:
Heap Buffer Overflow in heif_image_crop via Integer Underflow in ImageComponent::crop (strukturag/libheif#1746)

HeifPixelImage::ImageComponent::crop() at pixelimage.cc:1625 performs a memcpy with a size value derived from integer arithmetic that underflows to ~4GB (0xFFFFFFF4). A crafted HEIF file with specific crop coordinates triggers a massive heap-buffer-overflow READ of 4,294,967,284 bytes past a 20,751-byte buffer.

The image decodes to 72x72 pixels. Crop parameters (left=34, top=22, width=8, height=6) are within [0, image_dimension) and pass all application-level bounds checks, yet the internal stride/width arithmetic produces a negative signed value that gets cast to unsigned, wrapping to ~4GB and causing a massive OOB read in memcpy.

Severity: High (CWE-122: Heap-based Buffer Overflow, CWE-191: Integer Underflow).
